About us Technology is the most powerful tool humanity has to build a
more sustainable future. By combining the real and the digital worlds,
Siemens empowers customers to accelerate their digital and
sustainability transformations, making factories more efficient,
cities more livable, and transportation more sustainable. We believe
that organizations that can operationalize their sustainability
strategies with speed and scale will be the organizations that realize
growth and resilience. We are home to around 318,000 people who are
curious, inventive, and driven to make a difference. What sets us
apart isn’t just the passion for solving the world’s biggest
challenges — it’s the relentless focus on understanding and
serving our customers’ needs. This means pushing boundaries every
day. It means staying curious, staying agile — and finding joy in
learning and growth. We're seeking an Executive Storyteller &

impact narratives around her leadership agenda. Joining our
experienced CPSO Communications team at Siemens, you'll maximize the
CPSO's voice, impact, and reach while enhancing Siemens' perception as
a focused technology company in the age of AI. You're a strategic

complex people and sustainability topics – having also a thorough
understanding of the political landscape – into strong and inspiring
messages for diverse audiences. You are sparring with and supporting
the CPSO to create compelling content across all communication
channels in English and German. Your daily business Craft incisive,
thought-provoking and intellectually rigorous briefing materials,
speaking notes and strategic communications for the CPSO, including
panel discussions, keynote appearances and other high-profile internal
and external engagements, as well as compelling speeches and related
social media content in English and German. Tailor messages to diverse
audiences with deep understanding of communications across fields and
channels and also steer overarching communication projects related to

collaboration with Siemens businesses, functions, and Communications
colleagues Act as sparrings partner for CPSO through messaging
development, providing strategic counsel and guidance Analyze audience
feedback on the effectiveness of communications Support executive
communications planning, activity monitoring, and identifying new
opportunities with the Siemens Communications Team Your success is
grounded in Education : Master's degree in communications, humanities,
sustainability, business administration, or equivalent Experience &
Skills Extensive experience (+8 years) in communications and
speechwriting, with expertise in sustainability and people topics
Executive communications experience, ideally supporting C-level
leaders at technology companies Strong foundation in and passion for
people & organization and sustainability topics with a thorough
understanding of the German political and policy landscape. Ability to
develop thought leadership content Journalistic experience is a plus
Ways of working Ability to lead, manage, and collaborate with
international teams on complex projects Openness to learning,
feedback, and constructively challenging the status quo Proven team
player across business functions globally Strong focus and
prioritization skills in fast-paced, multi-project environments with
flexibility to shift as needs arise Bring strong AI literacy and a

speeches and communication strategies that position the CPSO at the
forefront of conversations on technology, people and the future of
work. Excellent social and networking skills across cultures and
management levels Languages: Outstanding written, verbal, and

Stellenbeschreibung:
About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.

You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.

We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.

Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.
- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.
- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.
- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.
- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.
- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.
- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.
- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.
- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.
- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.
- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.
- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.
- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.
- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.
- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.

What We Offer

- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.
- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.
- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.
- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.
- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.
- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.

We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.

If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.

Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.

katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)

jobs.description:
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers-and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Be part of Getinge as a

Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance

We are currently looking for an experienced Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance to join our Quality department in Aschheim-Dornach, Germany, or Solna, Sweden, part of the Critical Care product area at Getinge. This role will support the organization as the internal audit process owner, CAPA coordinator, and QA specialist, while continuously improving our quality management system and supporting quality-related projects (e.g., implementation of new tools, CAPA, etc.).

Own the internal audit process, plan the annual internal audit schedule, and follow up on internal audit findings
Conduct internal audits as an internal auditor
Support of external audits (notified bodies, authorities, customers)
Support of CAPA projects as CAPA coordinator
Collaboration in and owning internal Quality projects (management system plan, CAPA)
Continuous contribution to process improvement and alignment with other Critical Care sites
Provision and reporting of monthly KPIs
Maintenance, review and approval of QMS-related documentation and records as QA specialist

Degree in medical technology, engineering, science, or a similar relevant field
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in quality and environmental management, ideally in an ISO 13485 environment
Relevant knowledge of the implementation and application of applicable standards and regulations
Proven external and/or internal training in QM / ISO 13485 / FDA / EU MDR
Ideally trained as an Internal Auditor
Demonstrated experience in Quality- and Environmental-related projects (e.g., CAPAs, EU MDR uplift) is an advantage
Fluency in written and spoken English; Swedish or German (depending on the location) is an advantage
On-site presence of at least 1-2 days per week is expected; willingness to travel is required

In addition to your technical expertise, we highly value your personality. We believe you are a result-oriented and collaborative team player who takes ownership of your work and can operate independently when needed. You have strong analytical skills, a pragmatic mindset, and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels, and cultures. You thrive in a changing environment and approach challenges with professionalism and diplomacy.

We think you have an ambition for continuous development and a strong interest in staying up to date with the latest trends, regulations, and best practices within Quality Management, Medical Devices, and Supplier Quality.

At Getinge, we see ourselves as Team Players, Forward Thinkers, and Game Changers. We value proactive individuals who contribute to continuous improvement and organizational development.
We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits, and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.

Most importantly, this is a role where you can truly make a difference by contributing to the quality and safety of life-saving medical devices while helping shape the future of quality and compliance within Getinge.

jobs.occupation: Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical Entities (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical Entities

You are an experienced synthetic and process chemist with the ambition to shape the chemical foundation of our R&D pipeline for new chemical entities (NCEs) by designing, developing, and enabling synthetic routes that evolve into robust API manufacturing processes in partnership with our external CDMO network.

In this Drug Substance (DS) Lead position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. Serving as the central interface between internal stakeholders and external partners, you lead chemical process development and API supply activities, enabling phase-appropriate, scalable, and sustainable manufacturing processes that ensure timely API delivery, robust product quality, and cost efficiency.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Provide scientific leadership for the design, assessment, and optimization of synthetic routes for new APIs in preclinical and clinical phases, with a focus on speed, quality, cost, sustainability, and process understanding
- Represent Drug Substance (DS) in global CMC development project teams and contribute to key scientific, strategic, and portfolio decisions, while ensuring a coherent two-way flow of strategy, decisions, risks, and progress between the internal global CMC team and external CDMO activities
- Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy
- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight
- Steer process transfers between external partners and into internal development or external manufacturing, ensuring knowledge continuity and phase-appropriate documentation
- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions
- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities
- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundaries

WHO YOU ARE

- Ph.D. in Chemistry or a related science, with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including an understanding of GLP/GMP and regulatory expectations
- Strong background in synthetic chemistry, with an excellent understanding of reagents, methodologies, and reaction mechanisms, plus a solid grasp of analytical techniques
- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus
- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage
- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners
- A strategic thinker with the ability to think innovatively, develop and analyze multiple solutions to complex chemistry problems, and challenge the status quo
- Strong communication and project management skills across scientific disciplines, cultures, and organizational boundaries, combined with assertiveness, service orientation, and enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork
- Fluency in English (negotiation level), both written and spoken; German is an asset and willingness to learn German is required

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Be You. Be Bayer.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. Its key investment platforms include AURELIUS Opportunities V, AURELIUS European Opportunities IV, AUR Portfolio III and AURELIUS Growth (Wachstumskapital). AURELIUS has been growing significantly in recent years, especially expanding its global footprint, and today employs more than 400 professionals in 10 offices spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs

- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity

Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Senior Insights Consultant (f/m/d) for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You will be part of a team managing a multi-national big tracking program, managing local clients and global stakeholders. After your onboarding time, you will be responsible for leading the project setup & design, the client conversations and the team (functionally) for one of the product categories. You accompany and manage quantitative market research projects from conception to delivery on a national and international level. You support the consulting of clients regarding project design and methodological questions. You independently create proposals and calculations for study designs. You handle the coordination of project phases and work closely with internal interfaces as well as external service providers. You analyze study results, create meaningful reports, and present the results confidently to clients. You actively participate in the creation of pitch presentations and the expansion of existing client relationships. You work cross-departmentally within Ipsos Germany and maintain close exchange with global and European healthcare teams. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have 2-3 years of relevant experience in market research (institute or client side), ideally in healthcare, pharma, or medical technology. You have excellent knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, as well as strong understanding of advanced analytical techniques - but focus on recommending the right approaches and clearly explaining results, implications, and limitations to non-technical stakeholders rather than running analyses yourself. You demonstrate strong client management, communication, and storytelling skills, combined with analytical thinking and organizational strength. You are experienced in using modern project management tools and approaches. You are fluent in English; good level of German is preferred. You are open-minded, innovation-driven, and motivated to improve processes and efficiencies. You approach challenges with a proactive and confident mindset, navigating complex and unfamiliar situations effectively. You are a team player with flexibility and creativity. You have very good IT user skills, particularly in Office 365. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide!
